source_halves: Split unchanged raw samples at midpoint; scale each whole stereo covariance by a single trace ratio to the full-source trace. Do not normalize channels separately.
base: Unchanged actual C DNA,48s after2s warmup, frozen stereo_resonance_v1 verify1
transform: Closest lossless complex unitary mapping sorted base eigenvectors to target eigenvectors. Diagnostic bound only; no profile or audio export.
qualification: Require nonnegative target-minus-transformed-base eigenvalues for full and BOTH trace-normalized halves, plus both heldout shape improvements. Preserve every failure; do not add gain attenuation or search other bands/transforms until passing.
claim_boundary: An additive-feasibility bound under assumed second-order independence, not physical source/room separation, RPM/load calibration, or listening acceptance. Half-level normalization is diagnostic only, never applied to a listening file.
